_comment: Service discovery and mode config for AgentSynapse.
_note_coordinator: Coordinator is now part of AWM (port 8400) when AWM_COORDINATION=true. The separate packages/coordinator/ is deprecated.

models._doc: Default Claude model per agent role. Launchers read this to pass --model to claude CLI. Override per-agent in synapse.workspaces.json.

channels._doc: MCP push channels (Claude Code v2.1.80+, requires claude.ai Teams with channelsEnabled). When true, launchers pass --dangerously-load-development-channels server:awm and set AWM_CHANNEL_PORT per worker. The channel server (synapse-push/dist/channel-server.js) is spawned by Claude Code and receives assignments via HTTP from synapse-push, then emits notifications/claude/channel to wake the agent. Graceful degradation: if channels are not supported by the org, Claude Code does not spawn the server and workers fall back to /next polling automatically.
